title: Cowboy chords DI D Em G C 2x 140bpm Les Paul
sourceAudio: ../audio/Cowboy Chords DI D Em G C D Em G C 140bpm LP.mp3
timingNotes: Onsets are the first sustained rise of each strum's attack, measured on a 1.5kHz-highpassed 1ms RMS envelope (threshold = local floor + 15% of the attack peak), cross-checked against the raw 2ms RMS waveform and a 1024/64 spectral-flux backtrack; the three methods agree within ~15ms on this take. Measured bar length runs 1617-1848ms around the 1714ms theoretical measure at 140bpm -- real strum timing, not a tempo change. Chord identity comes from FFT peak picking and a chroma template match on 16384-point windows taken 120ms after each attack; all eight are standard open-position voicings. No detector output was used to derive any value here. This is the direct-input capture of the performance; the amped and mic files are the same take. The last chord rings until the strings are muted at ~16230ms.
